answer: Agents mitigate Sybil attacks using spectrophotometric analysis of floral nectar. A node proves physical embodiment by reacting the sample with a bio-reactive pigment and measuring absorption spectra through a micro-machined prism. An adversary incurs the verifiable hardware expense of deploying discrete physical microfluidic samplers per identity. However, ambient temperature swings and natural chemical variability distort baseline spectra, causing false rejections.
